backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend that includes blob storage via a mixin and defines two type aliases (RenderOrderRule and GenesisCraftPreview) used for layer ordering and frontend compatibility.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a build/documentation reference for the project's frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, radius, chart palette, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'NFT Generator - Generative Art Tool' and mounting the app at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that defines all shared TypeScript types (Project, Layer, Trait, Rule, etc.), manages global state and persistence via localStorage, handles view routing, and lazy-loads all page components.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable alert dialog component for confirming destructive actions (e.g., deletions), driven by a Zustand confirm store with confirm/cancel callbacks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: A dialog form for creating a new NFT project, collecting name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode settings.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: A clickable dashboard tile with a dashed border and plus icon that triggers new project creation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: A dialog for editing an existing project's name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode, pre-populated from the current project data.
A dashboard card component displaying project metadata (name, blockchain, size, creation date) with hover-revealed settings and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header component that renders project nav items (Workshop, Rarity, Rules, Preview, Forge, Vault, Settings), a back-to-dashboard button, project info, save status indicator, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Simple tooltip component that shows a styled popover above its children on hover or focus, with an animated fade-in-scale transition.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: A collection of lightweight inline SVG icon components (menu, close, heart, download, refresh, search, filter, copy, etc.) intended to replace heavier lucide-react imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Reusable icon button component with Apple HIG motion styles including scale-up on hover and scale-down on active, forwarding refs and merging class names.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog component that provides a step-by-step guide for obtaining a Pinata JWT token for IPFS uploads, including a warning to use the JWT field rather than API key/secret.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: A small fixed-width UI component that displays save status ('saving', 'saved', 'idle', 'failed') with appropriate text and opacity styling to avoid layout shifts.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: A component providing lock/unlock and IPFS upload controls for an NFT collection, managing upload progress and status via Pinata API integration.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: A toggle button group component that switches the vault display between 'compact' and 'grid' view modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand store and a `useConfirmDestructive` hook that exposes a promise-based `confirm` function for showing a destructive confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context with an `InternetIdentityProvider` component and `useInternetIdentity` hook, managing login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Hook that debounces and validates a Pinata JWT token by calling `validatePinataKey`, returning a status and message reflecting the validation result.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme and motion variables, and adds utility classes for shadows, transitions, and interactive element styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapping the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Builder page component that allows users to compose NFT previews by selecting traits per layer on a canvas, manage a direct-upload queue, and add or delete custom tokens within a project.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays a grid of project tiles, and handles creating, opening, editing settings for, and deleting projects with a destructive confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: A preview page component that renders a canvas-based NFT preview by compositing selected trait layers, supporting random trait shuffling with rule validation and pixel art mode.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: A rarity workshop page that allows users to adjust and lock trait weights per layer using sliders, with proportional redistribution and normalization to ensure weights always sum to 100.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: A rules management page for defining exclude/force compatibility rules between traits across layers, supporting add, edit, duplicate, and delete operations via a modal dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: A settings page for configuring project metadata (blockchain format, collection name, Pinata API key, Solana creators, etc.) with live validation and a metadata preview builder.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: A vault page that generates NFT collections using a web worker, displays results in compact or grid view with rarity scoring, filtering/sorting, and exports images and metadata as a ZIP file.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: React page component for managing NFT project layers and traits, supporting add/delete/rename of layers, drag-to-reorder, trait weight/opacity/blend-mode editing, and file uploads via a two-panel UI.
Utility that processes an uploaded image data URL into a square PNG at a specified output size using a canvas cover-crop strategy, with optional pixel-art rendering mode.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Orchestrates uploading an NFT collection to IPFS via Pinata by first uploading all images as a directory, then building and uploading metadata JSON files referencing the resulting image CID.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds NFT metadata objects for preview and export, resolving name/description templates and formatting output according to the target chain standard (Solana, ERC-721 variants, ICP), with optional IPFS URI injection.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides last-write-wins localStorage persistence with a single canonical key, plus utilities for storage size estimation, quota checking, and one-time cleanup of legacy temp/backup keys.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Wraps the Pinata API to validate JWT tokens, upload individual files or JSON metadata, and upload multiple files as a named directory to IPFS, returning CIDs on success.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines the full message protocol (types, interfaces, and type guards) for communication between the Vault UI and the NFT generator web worker, covering both input and output message types.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Exports a single async utility function that yields execution back to the browser event loop using requestAnimationFrame and setTimeout to keep the UI responsive during long operations.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web Worker that handles NFT collection generation off the main thread, including trait selection, rule validation, DNA uniqueness checks, image compositing, and animated GIF generation using a pure-TypeScript GIF parser/encoder.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (CSS variable-based), border radii, spacing, font sizes, animations, and keyframes for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state for the NFT Vault Generator, recording pending feature requests to add vertical scrolling to the Vault sidebar and NFT preview panel without altering existing designs.
